name: How much does a kitchen expansion typically cost in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does a kitchen expansion typically cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a kitchen expansion in the Bay Area can vary significantly depending on the scope, materials, and complexity. Minor expansions might range from $75,000 to $150,000, while larger, more complex projects involving structural changes, high-end finishes, and appliance upgrades can easily exceed $150,000, sometimes reaching $300,000 or more. Factors like the need for new foundations, extensive utility rerouting, and local permitting fees also impact the total investment. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen expansion costs in the Bay Area range from $75,000 to over $300,000, depending on project scope, materials, and structural complexity.
